title: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in…
description: OpenShot Video Editor versions through 4.1.1 have an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in the ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() functions. These functions pass non-JSON project files to Python's pickle.load() without restriction, allowing attackers to craft malicious .osp project files that execute arbitrary code with the user's privileges when opened.
